result.title: Directionally Factorized Illumination with Spherical Harmonic Rotation
result.summary: Many real-world capture scenarios involve an active light source rigidly attached to the camera: camera flashes for dark-environment imaging, underwater vehicle lights, and endoscopic/laparoscopic medical procedures. As the camera moves, the co-mounted light moves with it, causing the illumination direction at each surface point to change across views. Neural rendering methods (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting) encode this pose-dependent illumination as surface coloration, producing appearance inconsistencies and making it harder to recover the underlying scene. We present \textbf{DaFISH}, which can be plugged into any novel-view synthesis (NVS) pipeline such as NeRF. It factorizes per-point emitted color into surface albedo and a spherical harmonic (SH)-represented illumination factor. During training, the SH illumination is evaluated directly, enabling stable joint optimization of albedo, lighting, and geometry. \textbf{DaFISH} provides analytical generalization of illumination to arbitrary camera poses without retraining. Building on the closed-form SH-to-irradiance conversion, the training pipeline is fully differentiable from SH evaluation through volume rendering. Averaged over the held-out frames of the five scenes, \textbf{DaFISH} attains the best mean PSNR (38.91\,dB), SSIM (0.9613), and LPIPS (0.0582) among all compared methods. It improves over the strongest splatting baseline as well as the closest NeRF-based baseline, while recovering the scene consistently across views compared to prior methods.

AI.brief_summary: DaFISH 将逐点颜色分解为表面 albedo 与用球谐表示的照明因子，插入 NeRF 等新视角合成流程，联合优化 albedo、光照与几何，并可解析泛化到任意相机位姿。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属神经渲染与光照分解，虽涉及球谐与可微渲染，但既无多模态推理状态，也无证据获取、停止决策或 latent 生成机制，与 LVR 研究主线缺少实质联系。
